Frederick is making popsicles to sell and to save money he is making his own popsicle sticks. He can get 200 sticks from a 2 x 4 piece of wood and 400 sticks from a 2 x 8 piece of wood. He has $120 to buy wood for sticks. A 2 x 4 costs $10. A 2 x 8 costs $12. What is the most popsicle sticks he can make if he buys the cheapest lumber?

It takes John 500 minutes to get to the first side of the Rubik's cube. The second and third sides each take twice that long. The last 2 sides each take half as long as the first, and once you get the 5th side you have all 6 sides. How long does the Rubik's cube take?
It is approximately 1955000 meters from San Diego, California to New York City, New York. If Bernice drove 325000 meters for 4 days, how many kilometers will she still need to drive?

Brian's basement was damp and musty, so he bought a dehumidifier to remove moisture out of the air. The device has three speeds: low, medium, and high. Brian tested the device's efficiency and he found that the low setting removes 10 liters of water out of the air per day, the medium setting removes twice as much water per day as the low setting, and the high setting removes twice as much water per day as the medium setting. If Brian ran the dehumidifier for 30 days on the low setting, then an additional 30 days on the medium setting, and then an additional 50 days on the high setting, what is the total amount of water that the dehumidifier removed from the air in his basement, in liters?

At the local Pick Your Own fruit orchard, you could pick your own peaches for $20.00 per pound, plums were $10.00 per pound and apricots were $30.00 per pound. If Winston picked 60 pounds of peaches, 80 pounds of plums and 60 pounds of apricots, how much did he spend on fruit?

Brook Hills High School currently enrolls 30000 students. Half of these students are over 16 years old, and one-fourth of the students over 16 years old are male. The remaining half of the students are under 16 years old, and one-half of the students under 16 are male. In total, how many female students are enrolled at this school?
Bob spends $2700000 distributed between 30 schools to buy books. He can buy 1000 books for $5000. How many books can he buy per school?

Patrick has three glue sticks that are partially used. One has 1/6 left, the second has 2/3 left and the third one has 1/2 left. If a glue stick is 1200 millimeters long originally, what is the total length of the glue sticks that are not used?
Travis had 610 apps on his tablet. He deleted 90 apps that he didn't use anymore and downloaded 180 more. How many apps are on his tablet now?
Marcus is half of Leo’s age and fifteen years younger than Deanna. Deanna is 26. How old is Leo?

48 people are riding a bus. On the first stop, 10 passengers get off, and 5 times as many people as the number who got off from the bus get into the bus. On the second stop 21, passengers get off and 3 times fewer passengers get on. How many passengers are riding the bus after the second stop?

Adam has $10000 and wants to spend it to open a rock stand. He can buy rocks for $50 each and sell them for $70 each. If he invests all his money in the rock stand but only sells 60% of his inventory, how much money does he lose?

Stetson made a bet with Alec that he would give up $100 for each orange he eats. While at the farm, Stetson ate 2/5 of the oranges they picked. If they picked 600 oranges, calculate the total amount of money Stetson gave up?
Valerie earns $50,000 per month, which is 1/2 of what her brother earns. If their mother earns twice their combined salary, what's the total amount of money they all earn together in a month?

Lucy sells apples from her orchard at $4 per piece. On Monday, she sold all the apples picked. On Tuesday, she picked 12 apples. Come Wednesday, Lucy picked double the number of apples she did the previous day. If Lucy got $112 from selling the apples picked on Monday, how many apples did she pick over the three days?
Henry and 3 of his friends order 70 pizzas for lunch. Each pizza is cut into 80 slices. If Henry and his friends want to share the pizzas equally, how many slices can each of them have?

Jerome had 40 friends who came to visit him on a certain day. The first friend pressed on the doorbell 200 times before Jerome opened, the second friend pressed on the doorbell 1/4 times more than Jerome's first friend. The third friend pressed on the doorbell 100 times more than the fourth friend. If the fourth friend pressed on the doorbell 600 times, how many doorbell rings did the doorbell make?

A pink frog weighs the same as a blue beetle, the same as a green toad, 5000 grams less than a yellow snake, but 10000 grams more than a red bird. If the pink frog weighs 25000 grams, calculate the total weight of a container carrying one of each animal if the container also weighs 10000 grams.

Finley took part in a 100-meter race.  She started off in first, but then fell back 10 spots.  She then moved ahead 2 spots, before falling behind 3.  Lastly, she jumped ahead 1 spot to finish the race.  What place did she finish in?
Davos bought 20 shirts from the mall that cost $300 each. If he bought them with a 40% discount, how much did Davos pay for the 20 shirts?
In November, a toy was $4000. In December, the price increased by 80%. In January, the price decreased by 50%. What was the price of the toy after it was discounted in January?

Sally has realized she did not receive her full wage this week. Her bank account, which held $20,000 at the start of the week, now holds $42,000. She has received no other money into her bank account this week. If her weekly wage should be $30,000, how many dollars were withheld from Sally’s wage?

Adam went to a store to buy some sweets. He bought 70 candies of type A and 100 candies of type B. One candy of type A costs $0.5, and one candy of type B costs $0.75. How much change did Adam get, if he paid the cashier $150?
Rosie can run 10 miles per hour for 3 hours. After that, she runs 5 miles per hour. How many miles can she run in 10 hours?

Sandra, the florist around the corner, is very unhappy with Fred's incomplete order delivery. Sandra had ordered four thousand times as many red roses as white carnations. She also ordered 200,000 pink calla lilies, which were five hundred times the number of white carnations. Sandra has threatened to switch suppliers if the missing red roses are not delivered by 5 pm. To keep Sandra's business, how many red roses must Fred deliver by 5 pm?

Mr. Smith has two farms, Farm X and Farm Y. He has 550 goats in Farm X and 450 goats in Farm Y. He sold 100 goats from Farm X and twice as many goats from Farm Y. How many goats are left in the two farms altogether?

Julia and Nadine were given the same amount of allowance by their mother. The two girls decided to combine their allowance to surprise their father on his 100th birthday. They bought a cake which costs $110. They also bought 10 dozen balloons which were sold for $5 for 20 balloons. The remaining money was used to buy 20 tubs of ice cream for $70 each. How much did Julia and Nadine's mother give each one of them?

Jamie earns $20 per hour for 10 hours of work each day. Should she need to work additional hours, she is paid a special hourly rate that is 150% of her regular hourly rate. Last Tuesday, she worked 11 hours. How much was she paid, in dollars, for her work that day?

The power goes out in Brianna's house one night so she and her family gather all their candles and flashlights. There are 10 rooms in the house and 4 people living there, including Brianna. There is a flashlight for every person to carry and two for each room. They have a variety of candles available; 12 small candles each for half the rooms and 10 medium candles each for the other half of the rooms. With everything combined, how many candles and flashlights are Brianna's family using when the lights go out?

A $20,000 watch was put on sale so that Mr. Rogers bought it at 75% of its original price. He then sold the watch to his friend at 120% of the price that he bought it. What is the percentage discount obtained by Mr. Roger's friend from the original price?

Each sleeve of graham crackers makes the base for 80 large smores. There are 30 sleeves in a box. If 90 kids want 20 smores apiece and 60 adults will eat 10 smores apiece, how many boxes of graham crackers will they need?

On Monday, the post office delivered 4250 letters. On Tuesday, they delivered 170 more than one-fifth as many as Monday. On Wednesday, they delivered 50 more than twice as many as they delivered on Tuesday. How many letters did the post office deliver from Monday to Wednesday?
Castle bought 30 boxes of Coco Crunch and 50 boxes of Fruit Loops this week. Last week she bought 40 boxes of cereal. How many more boxes of cereal did she buy this week than last week?

George needs to pay for extensive dental work. He needs 20 implants. Each implant has a base price of $20000. For one of the implants, he wants a crown made of porcelain. That feature costs an extra $5000. He’s already put down a deposit of $6000. He makes $150 per hour at work. How many hours does he need to work before he has enough to pay for the dental work?

Four students scored a total of 2510 points in a board game. Naomi scored 680 of the points. Yuri scored 10 more than half as many points as Naomi and Brianna scored 170 points more than Naomi. How many points did Jojo score?

Sunny is selling gingerbread and apple pie for a fundraiser. On Saturday, he sold 100 boxes of gingerbread and 40 fewer boxes of apple pie, than on Sunday. On Sunday, he sold 50 more boxes of gingerbread than on Saturday and 150 boxes of apple pie. If the gingerbread cost $60 and the apple pie cost $150, how much did Sunny earn for two days?

Mel uses a 900-watt air conditioner for 10 hours a day. This means that each hour the AC uses 900 watts of energy. If he reduces the time he uses the air conditioner by 5 hours a day, how many kilowatts of electric energy will he save in 100 days?
Jay is making snowballs to prepare for a snowball fight with his sister. He can build 20 snowballs in an hour, but 2 melt every 15 minutes. How long will it take before he has 120 snowballs?
Tyrion changes his face mask two times every time he goes out. If he goes out 11 times a day, how many face masks does he use every 257 days?

A class of 5000 students has various hobbies. 1000 like to bake, 500 like to play basketball, and the rest like to either play video games or play music. How many like to play video games if the number that like to play music is twice the number that prefer playing basketball?

Isabelle bought party supplies for her little sister’s birthday party. She spent $120 on ingredients for the cake, $430 on birthday presents, $150 on decorations, $40 on invitations, and $220 on goodie bags for the party guests. She split the cost evenly three ways with her two parents. How many dollars did each person pay?
Gary does laundry twice a week. Each load of laundry uses 200 gallons of water, and a gallon of water costs $0.015. How much does Gary spend on water for laundry in a year?

Nissa hires 6000 seasonal workers to play elves in her department store's Santa village. A third of the elves quit after children vomit on them, then 1000 of the remaining elves quit after kids kick their shins. How many elves are left?

Jerry has two pools, both with leaks emptying them out at 12 gallons/minute. 40 minutes ago, the big pool had twice as much water as the small pool. Now the big pool has four times as much water as the small pool. How much water does the small pool have now?
If there are 100 eggs in a basket, and there are twice as many eggs in a second basket, how many eggs are in both baskets put together?

Jackie is trying to decide whether to do her taxes herself or hire an accountant. If she does the taxes herself, she'll be able to do 3 fewer hours of freelance work, losing $135/hour in missed income. The accountant charges $190. How much more money will she have if she hires the accountant?
Every 20 miles a car drives, the tires rotate 7,250 times. Jeremy drives 4,000 miles a month. If each tire can undergo 104,400,000 rotations, how many years before the tire needs to be replaced?

Coach brought one bag filled with basketballs to practice and dumped them all out onto the gym floor before practice began. After the practice time was over, he asked Jordan, Jason, and Jeffrey to pick up the balls and carry them over to the bag. The three boys picked up and carried all of the balls in one trip. Jordan carried twice as many balls as Jason, and Jason carried twice as many balls as Jeffrey. If Jason had picked up and carried 200 balls, what is the total number of balls that the coach brought to practice?

A mechanic charges different rates to repair the tires of trucks and cars. For each truck tire that is repaired, the mechanic will charge $600 and for each car tire that is repaired, the mechanic will charge $400. On Thursday, the mechanic repairs 60 truck tires and 40 car tires. On Friday, the mechanic repairs 120 car tires and doesn't repair any truck tires. How much more revenue did the mechanic earn on the day with higher revenue?

Kim sleepwalks, to monitor her sleeping hours, she installs a camera in her room. Kim usually goes to sleep at 10 p.m. and wakes up at 6 a.m. She is a sleepwalker. One day, after reviewing the cameras, she finds that she woke up that day and was sleepwalking from 2:15 to 2:38 am.  Also, that day she woke up 10 minutes earlier than usual to go to the bathroom. How many minutes did she sleep on her bed that day?
Together, Sofie, Anne, and Fawn have 8500 books. If Sofie has 2500 more books than Anne, and Anne has 1200 fewer books than Fawn does, how many books does Fawn have?
Axel has 150 silver pesos and 100 gold pesos. He visits his friend Anna who has twice as many silver pesos as he has and 40 more gold pesos. What's the total number of pesos they have together?

Artemis is potting flowers with her father. They buy a 3000-pound bag of soil. Each rose needs 10 pounds. Each carnation needs 15 pounds. Each Sunflower needs 30 pounds. If they plant 40 sunflowers and 100 carnations, how many roses can they plant?

An ice cream truck is traveling through a neighborhood. Children from various homes have started chasing the truck and, by the time the truck has reached the end of the first street, there are 10 children it. On the second street, each child is joined by another child and on the third street, each child in the existing group is joined by another 2 children. The original 10 children then give up and leave the group. How many children are now following the truck?

Toula went to the bakery and bought various types of pastries. She bought 30 dozen donuts which cost $680 per dozen, 20 dozen mini cupcakes which cost $800 per dozen, and 60 dozen mini cheesecakes for $550 per dozen. How much was the total cost?

A customs officer at the main port of SeaSide clearances counted 20 containers of imported vehicles, each having 50 vehicles inside. The next day, more containers were brought in, and the total number of vehicles at the port became 3000. Calculate the number of containers that were imported on the second day, assuming all the containers contain 50 vehicles.

The ratio of the electric poles and electric wires needed to connect and supply the electricity in a certain neighborhood is 1:3. If the total number of electric wires needed to connect the electricity in the neighborhood is 4500, calculate the total number of electric poles required by an electric company to supply the electricity in the neighborhood.

The marching band is ordering new uniforms. Each uniform comes with a hat that costs $250, a jacket that costs three times as much as the hat, and pants that cost the average of the costs of the hat and jacket. How much does each uniform cost total?

Colorado City uses 3% of the water from the Colorado River. If 9% of that water is used for industrial purposes, what percent of the river's total water is used by the city for non-industrial purposes?

Bob believes he needs 5600 popsicle sticks to recreate the Washington Monument for his history project. His favorite popsicles come 80 to a box and cost $20.00 per box. How much will it cost Bob to build his project?

In a student council election, candidate A got 20% of the votes while candidate B got 50% more than candidate A's votes. The rest of the votes was given to candidate C. If there were 10000 voters, how many votes did candidate C get?
Wendy wants to place 200 more than double the number of books in a shelving system with 60 rows and 60 columns. How many books will she need to carry to complete her task?
Ducks need to eat 1400 grams of insects each week to survive. If there is a flock of ten ducks, how many grams of insects do they need per day?

I have 100 liters of orange drink that are two-thirds water and I wish to add it to 150 liters of pineapple drink that is three-fifths water. But as I pour it, I spill 10 liters of the orange drink. How much water is in the remaining 240 liters?

Ricardo grows tomatoes and eggplants in his garden. Each tomato plant yields 220 tomatoes while each plant of eggplant yields 40 eggplants. He planted 50 tomato plants and 80 plants of eggplant. How many fruits can Ricardo harvest from his plants?
